Position

The Host City Manager will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup TM.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

Host Cities

  • Belo Horizonte
  • Brasília
  • Fortaleza
  • Porto Alegre
  • Recife
  • Rio de Janeiro
  • Salvador
  • São Paulo

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

    Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.

    Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.

    Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

  2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

    Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.

    Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.

    Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

  3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

    Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).

    Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.

    Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

  4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

    Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.

    Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.

    Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.

  5. Reporting and Governance

    Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

Your Profile

Education

Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.

Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)

Requirements

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently.

title: Director, Business Development Lifestyle - Latam
description:
Who We Are

Authentic Brands Group (ABG) is a brand development, marketing and entertainment company, which owns a portfolio of global media, entertainment and fashion lifestyle brands.

ABG elevates and builds the long-term value of more than 50 consumer brands and properties by partnering with best-in-class manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers.

We are committed to transforming brands by delivering compelling product, content, business and immersive experiences.

We create and activate original marketing strategies to drive the success of our brands across all consumer touchpoints, platforms and emerging media.

Why ABG

The mission of ABG is to evolve, transform and reimagine global brands through innovative business models, powerful storytelling, compelling content, and immersive experiences.

Working at ABG isn't like working at other companies.

Let's chat if you're creative and hungry to drive ideas into action.

We work with some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more.

Join us in working toward our mission.

What You’ll Do

As the Business Development Director, Lifestyle LATAM you’ll be developing and executing strategies for expanding ABG’s base of licensing partnerships, increasing the footprint of the company’s brands, and ultimately delivering top‑line revenue for the organization in the LATAM region.

If you’re a strategic thinker with a creative spirit and are driven to win, we’d like to meet you.

We’re proud to offer our BD Executives unlimited commission and are excited to welcome eager sellers to our team.

What You’ll Be Working On

Generate Qualified Leads

  • Learn and understand ABG’s brand strategies.
  • Research the market and identify new Fashion Lifestyle licensing partners that map to your brand portfolio and meet ABG’s partner qualifications.

Build and Manage Sales Pipeline

  • Continually drive prospects into leads through high‑volume outbound sales activity.
  • Utilize detailed discovery to learn about the prospect’s interests and capabilities.
  • Partner with Business Development leadership and Brand Marketing to develop pitch decks that clearly align the brand value proposition with the prospect’s interests and capabilities.

Drive the Licensing Deal to Close

  • Work in partnership with Brand Management and Business Development Leadership teams to develop business plans and formulate product licensing proposals.
  • Lead and manage efficient and productive negotiations of deal terms, taking full ownership of the deal process.
  • Assemble detailed term sheets with concise business terms.
  • Work closely with legal counsel to draft licensing agreements.

Sales Management

  • Track sales activity in CRM consistently and accurately.
  • Manage productive and goal‑oriented deal processes.
  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts per ABG’s sales reporting process.
  • Prepare reports and presentations of sales performance as needed.
  • Responsible for quota attainment in assigned business pillar.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years experience in new business development in licensing for Lifestyle, Beauty, Fashion markets in the LATAM region.
  • 5+ years experience in full‑cycle sales from lead generation through closing the deal in the LATAM region.
  • Have knowledge and understanding of licensees and product categories.
  • Possess an eager demeanor with a fearless and professional drive to win; substantial cold calling and other forms of outreach are required.
  • Success at negotiating licensing contracts, creatively developing new business ideas.
  • Able to partner closely with licensees to understand their business needs and explore opportunities for growth.
  • Understand licensing sales successes and challenges, key retail accounts, development plans and strategy.
  • Understand best practices for Licensees.
  • Has a bachelor’s degree.
  • Must be willing and able to travel occasionally as the role requires.

Authentic Brands Group is an equal‑opportunity employer and we value and embrace diversity and inclusion of all Team Members.

We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, national origin, disability, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or other legally protected status.

description:
Motive Offshore Group specialises in the design, manufacture, rental, and inspection of marine and lifting equipment and is committed to delivering sustainable, innovative, and multi‑sector solutions.

We have many exciting opportunities globally as we rapidly expand our reach, especially in low‑carbon and energy transition areas.

Our People are our most valuable asset.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative, and collaborative workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to achieve their full potential.

We celebrate diversity in all its forms and are dedicated to creating a culture of equity and belonging.

About the role

Hours: Full‑Time

The Inspection Supervisor will lead and supervise all inspection, NDT, and rope‑access activities.

The role includes ensuring full compliance with IRATA Level III rigging and safety requirements.

Duties involve planning, coordinating, and carrying out routine and periodic surveys using the full range of NDT methods and inspection equipment.

Onsite training, mentoring, and performance oversight for Inspectors are also key components of the position, as is undertaking all tasks associated with a Level III Rope Access Supervisor.

Additional responsibilities include ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest technical standards, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and contributing to the development and implementation of inspection procedures and best practices.

Responsibilities

People

Adopt and promote the Motive Offshore Group People Values and ensure their use is embedded throughout.

Develop strong working relations with key stakeholders – clients, colleagues, etc.

Act as a positive ambassador for Motive Offshore Group Ltd.

Uphold the Motive Offshore Group People Values.

Planet

Lead by example in setting the highest possible standards in the promotion of People Values, HSEQ procedures and best practice, ensuring compliance to the Motive Offshore Group HSEQ Policy, procedures, standards and regulatory obligations.

Immediately report all accidents, incidents, near misses or environmental concerns.

Adhere to and participate in company‑wide sustainability policies, procedures and initiatives as they are developed to support our Net Zero objectives.

Product

Provide Rope Access supervision, advice and support.

Perform Rope Access activities and act as Level III Rope Access Supervisor for tasks such as NDT, structural installations and removals, shot blasting and painting.

Rig up and inspect rope access equipment prior to and during use.

Carry out routine surveys, inspections and load testing of lifting equipment and their accessories, and immediately report defects or concerns.

Maintain the compilation of all hours undertaken for rope access activities and report findings to the rope access manager.

Mentor other Spooling and Inspection Rope Access Technicians.

Ensure all rope access equipment is maintained.

Attend rope access refresher and other associated training as required.

Where qualified, carry out visual and NDT examination of all types of high‑performance wire rope.

Where qualified, carry out pressure lubrication of all types of high‑performance wire ropes in accordance with working procedures and COSHH assessments.

Complete Daily Client Service Record and Rope Access forms in full, with accurate times and descriptions, obtaining signed approval from the client where required.

Properly set up equipment.

Use Kinetic Software for the review, approval and production of good‑quality inspection reports ready to send to customers.

Travel to worldwide destinations as and when required.

Required skills / knowledge

Significant offshore experience.

Suitable NDT certification (SNT or PCN Level II).

IRATA Rope Access Level III.

Offshore certification.

Experience operating machinery.

Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.

Ability to prioritise.

Strong organisational skills with a good ability to prioritise and work to deadlines.

Ability to cope with change in a busy working environment.

What we can offer you

As a global business, you will be colleagues with people not only in the UK but also in Taiwan, Singapore, the UAE, Norway, Brazil and the US.

You will be part of our people‑centred approach that supports clients and projects across multiple countries.

Motive has enabled school leavers to advance to senior positions, relocate to other parts of the world, and develop technical skills through training.

How to Apply & what happens next

Send us a resume with any supporting documents telling us why you'd like to work with us at Motive Offshore Group.

Once we've reviewed your application, we'll be back in touch as soon as possible to update you on the next stages.

If you have any questions about the role or want to chat about what life is like at Motive Offshore Group, email us at .

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup TM ("FWWC") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives.

This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication.

The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner‑related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.

This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high‑quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey.

This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.

We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large‑scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament‑time.

The ideal candidate understands the mindset of a volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large‑scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme.
  • Ensure alignment with FIFA Women’s World Cup strategy, FIFA’s global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines.
  • Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.

  • Co‑lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
  • Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.
  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
  • Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
  • Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
  • Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end‑to‑end RFP process.
  • Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner‑related activities and tournament‑time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
  • Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how‑to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
  • Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross‑functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
  • Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
  • Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
  • Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.

Your Profile

  • University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
  • Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
  • Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
  • Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
  • Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large‑scale communication plans.
  • Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS / web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity).
  • Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.

  • Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil / South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
  • Positive, collaborative, solutions‑driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
  • Team‑oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.

  • Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables.

We are looking for a Junior Tax Analyst to support our Tax Team with Brazilian tax demands. This role is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to deepen their experience in tax compliance within a dynamic, global, and technology-driven environment. Our VTEX Tax Team manages every aspect related to tax planning and compliance, focusing on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement of our global tax operations. In Brazil, the team plays a critical role in ensuring compliance with local requirements while collaborating with other regions to maintain alignment with global standards. As part of this team, you will:

  • Support tax and accounting activities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax regulations;
  • Review and assist in preparing Direct and Indirect Tax calculations and returns;
  • Register and reconcile journal entries related to tax accounts (recoverable, payable, and expense accounts);
  • Keep the accounting reconciliations for tax accounts updated and accurate;
  • Support the implementation and improvement of SOX controls;
  • Stay up to date with changes in Brazilian tax legislation, sharing key updates with the team;
  • Help clarify withholding tax questions from internal stakeholders;
  • Assist in preparing documentation for tax audits and inspections;
  • Collaborate with local and global teams to ensure alignment between tax, accounting, and finance processes.

  • You are based in Rio de Janeiro and willing to go to the office 1–2x a week;
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (completed or in progress) in Accounting, Business Administration, Law, Economics, or related areas;
  • You have 1–2 years of experience in Tax or Accounting, ideally in a corporate environment or consulting firm;
  • Basic to solid understanding of Brazilian tax legislation;
  • Knowledge of journal entries and reconciliation of tax accounts (assets, liabilities, and P&L);
  • Someone with previous experience with SAP or other ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
  • Advanced user of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets;
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset;
  • Intermediate English - comfortable reading documentation and communicating with global peers when necessary;

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2.4 thousand global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3.4 thousand active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024). title: Local Manager
description:
Result of Service

Result of Service

  • The Local Manager reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office.

He / She shall duly and timely perform his / her obligations, under these Terms of Reference.

The consultant will work in close collaboration with UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Petrópolis, RJ, Brazil

Expected duration

Six (6) months with possibility of renewal

Background

The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all.

Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda.

UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity.

It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development.

The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean - ROLAC - is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The agency focuses on developing and managing activities in the host country.

In recent years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil, working with the three levels of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participatory and equitable urban economic, social and environmental policies.

In this context, "Inclusive and Sustainable Rio" is a project between UN-Habitat and the Government of the State of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro - GERJ), through the Undersecretariat of Water Resources and Environmental Sustainability (Subsecretaria de Recursos Hídricos e Sustentabilidade Ambiental), which aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro, based on the implementation of the Agenda and the principles of the New Urban Agenda.

The project will help the State to achieve urban prosperity, while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas.

Specifically, the proposal focuses on: expanding the commitment of the State's direct and indirect administration to accelerate the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), complementing the Fluminense Government's global call to action - Rio, and establishing a culture of sustainability in the State of Rio de Janeiro that contributes to increasing urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation policies and the engagement of local youth.

Therefore, we are looking for a Local Manager to work on the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio project in its product to mobilize the city of Petrópolis and its citizens towards non-structural actions to reduce disaster risks in the city.

Report to UN-Habitat Manager: The Local Manager reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him / her.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, supervise, guide and support field teams.
  • Provide technical and operational support during activities.
  • Act as the focal point between the project and the community, building trust and collaboration.
  • Promote community awareness of preventive and preparation actions and the role of each group in risky situations.
  • Plan field activities ensuring alignment with community needs.
  • Establish schedules and strategies for efficient execution of actions.
  • Contribute to the actions of field agents, in case of risk of disasters, directing the community population to reception locations.
  • Evaluate field action execution, identify improvement opportunities, and propose adjustments to Field Supervisor.
  • Identify and manage potential conflicts during field operations, seeking quick and effective solutions.
  • Adapt execution strategies according to territorial specifics or unforeseen circumstances.
  • Identify training needs or adjustments for teams and report them to Field Supervisor.
  • Support the training team when they are promoting training with the community in which they will be involved.
  • Develop activities to strengthen community resilience and implement actions to mitigate environmental impacts and reduce disaster risks.
  • Expand educational actions to promote a culture of resilience.
  • Produce monthly reports on personal work activities.
  • Produce detailed monthly reports on field activities, including performance indicators and challenges faced.

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect :

About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting ourVI-P Guide, which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role, with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “ moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact : You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities : Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking : Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth : Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

  • You own the outcome : You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame.
  • You level up fast : You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10.
  • You close the loop : You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact.
  • You stay cool under pressure : Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team : You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have :

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

Career Switchers

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First : All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours : Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave : There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget : You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited toyourwork setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech : New joiners receive abudget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro Nossa história começou em , com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível. Foco no cliente : Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Sonho grande : Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos. Mente aberta : Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre. Espírito empreendedor : Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono. Sobre a Oportunidade: Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos. Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro. Na XP Inc.

Você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro.

Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Pré-requisitos

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI);
  • Diferenciais: Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros); CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT. Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP!

Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc.

Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura: Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida. Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias. Só na XP Inc.

Assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos. Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade. O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes.

É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.

Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Processo seletivo: análise de currículo, testes de alinhamento cultural, entrevistas com recrutamento, liderança, Head Comercial, foco em cultura, oferta.

Buscamos construir um ambiente seguro e inclusivo para o desenvolvimento profissional de todas as pessoas e não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

In this key leadership role based in our Altens office in Aberdeen, you’ll drive Quality and HSES excellence across Surface UK operations in both Aberdeen and Dunfermline. This role is key to ensuring robust processes and systems that support our business goals and deliver outstanding results.

You’ll champion a culture of continuous improvement, inspiring the right behaviours and fostering collaboration throughout the organization. As a trusted influencer, you’ll build strong relationships while managing and developing the Quality and HSES functions in alignment with TechnipFMC’s strategy, policies, and industry standards.

If you’re passionate about safety, quality, and leadership—and want to shape the future of our operations—this is your opportunity to lead with purpose.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor, coach, and inspire your team to build a strong Quality and HSE culture.
  • Drive QHSES awareness and continuous improvement across all UK bases.
  • Act as a trusted influencer, promoting best practices and positive behaviours.

QHSES Management

  • Implement and monitor our Business Process Management System (BPMS).
  • Ensure compliance with local, national, and international HSE regulations.
  • Develop and maintain QHSES policies and programs aligned with TechnipFMC standards.
  • Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Support initiatives like standardization and 5S.
  • Oversee Management Reviews and KPI reporting.
  • Facilitate Non-Conformance and CAPA processes.
  • Align QHSES objectives with business True North goals.

Risk & Change Management

  • Coach teams on risk assessment methodologies.
  • Promote and guide the Management of Change (MOC) process.

Audits & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits and support regional programs.
  • Prepare for and manage external audits (certification bodies, customer audits).
  • Ensure compliance with API Q2, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and HSE legislation.

Training & Development

  • Deliver QHSES training and awareness initiatives.

Operational Support

  • Encourage proactive hazard identification and reporting.
  • Monitor environmental aspects (waste, emissions, spill prevention).
  • Review client / project documentation and support tender / bid processes.

Security & Emergency Response

  • Act as site Security focal point and emergency response team member.
  • Maintain risk assessments and crisis management plans.

Incident Management

  • Lead investigations using TapRooT, TopSet, and other recognized methodologies.
  • Conduct safety drills and behavioural safety observations.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and develop the Quality team.
  • Foster accountability, safety, and quality across all functions.
  • Support operational readiness and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

Visits to workshop and storage areas required, these environments may be noisy, dusty, subject to temperature variations depending on the season.

May be opportunities to travel to other Surface locations to attend training events, participate in audits, operational meetings.

No significant physical demands are associated with this role.

Education & Certifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Occupational Safety, or related field.
  • NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent HSE certification.
  • Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).

Experience

  • Proven experience in HSES, Quality Assurance, or Quality Control.
  • Energy industry background (preferred).
  • Strong PC skills (Office 365); ERP knowledge (SAP desirable).
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.

Skills & Attributes

  • Excellent communication and coaching skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Expertise in root cause analysis and process improvement.
  • Knowledge of Lean tools and risk assessment methodologies.
  • Familiarity with ISO standards and API Q2.

The positon

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.

  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

Como analista de monetização júnior para um aplicativo de recompensas (rewards) você atuará na implementação e análise de estratégias para gerar receita mantendo o engajamento dos usuários. Seu foco será em otimizar os modelos de monetização existentes como publicidade compras internas (in-app purchases) e assinaturas.

Como atuará :

  • Implementa modelos de monetização : Colabora na configuração e no teste de diferentes formas de gerar receita como anúncios in-app (via plataformas como Google AdMob) e ofertas de compra dentro do aplicativo.
  • Analisa o desempenho : Monitora métricas-chave (KPIs) como receita média por usuário (ARPU) custo por instalação (CPI) e taxas de conversão. Você usará dados para entender o que está funcionando e o que precisa ser ajustado.
  • Otimiza a estratégia : Ajuda a identificar oportunidades para aumentar a receita sem comprometer a experiência do usuário. Em um aplicativo de recompensas isso pode incluir equilibrar a frequência dos anúncios ou o valor das recompensas.
  • Colabora com outras equipes : Trabalha em conjunto com as equipes de produto marketing e desenvolvimento para garantir que as estratégias de monetização estejam alinhadas com os objetivos do aplicativo e com o comportamento dos usuários.
  • Cria relatórios : Prepara relatórios básicos de desempenho para a equipe sênior mostrando os resultados das iniciativas de monetização e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Monitora a concorrência : Pesquisa o que outros aplicativos de recompensas estão fazendo em termos de monetização para ajudar a identificar as melhores práticas.

Atenção : Vaga extensiva para pessoas com deficiência.

Requisitos

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia Ciências Contábeis Finanças ou em áreas correlatas a Negócios Marketing Digital ou Análise de Dados.

Para a posição júnior é essencial ter bom raciocínio analítico afinidade com números e disposição para aprender continuamente sobre métricas e ferramentas de monetização.

Outras características :

  • Mentalidade analítica : Capacidade de interpretar dados e métricas para tirar conclusões e fazer recomendações.
  • Noções de finanças : Entendimento de conceitos como receita custo e retorno sobre investimento (ROI).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas : Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e relatórios como Google Analytics ou plataformas de monetização como Google AdMob.
  • Proatividade : O analista júnior precisa ser curioso e proativo na busca por novas formas de melhorar os resultados.
  • Comunicação : Habilidade para comunicar de forma clara as análises e sugestões para a equipe.

The Data Analyst will work in close collaboration with the Programme Coordinators, the operational and technical teams of UN-Habitat offices in Rio de Janeiro, as well as with the local project team, staff of other UN Agencies, Government officials, media, multilateral and bilateral donors and civil society.

  • Work Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil
  • Expected duration: Six (6) months upon the signature of the contract, with the possibility of renewal.

Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all.

Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda.

UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity.

It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development.

UN-Habitat's Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean - ROLAC - is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country.

Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies.

As part of a partnership with the Municipality of São Paulo, the project includes the revision of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan (PGIRS) and the elaboration of the Municipal Sanitation Plan (PMSB).

In order to properly implement this project, a Data Analyst is required to ensure that both plans are technically executed correctly.

Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him / her.

Outputs / Work Assignment The Data Analyst shall support and advise on the implementation of projects according to the responsibilities indicated below.

title: Vice President Of Sales - Latam
description:
About GTT

GTT is a leading networking and security as a service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. We serve thousands of organizations, bringing together the right people, partners and technology to reduce the burden on IT teams and solve the most pressing networking and security challenges. Built on our top‑ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks, enabling customers with consumable solutions to achieve business missions and meet ongoing demand when, where and how needed. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD‑WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the globe. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together.

Role Summary

The VP, Sales - LATAM drives strategic market expansion for GTT by developing and nurturing high‑value, long‑term relationships with key Carrier, Wholesale, and Strategic Alliance partners across the Latin American region. This role focuses on ecosystem development, identifying and securing new business models, and creating sustainable revenue channels through partnerships, rather than direct transactional sales. The Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic plan to significantly increase GTT's market presence and network reach in LATAM.

Job Scope and Stakeholder Engagement

This role serves as a strategic bridge between GTT's offerings and the LATAM carrier market.

  • External Focus: Primary interaction is with executive and strategic planning teams at Target Carrier Partners, Global Data Center Providers, and potential Channel Partners to establish commercial, network, and technology alliances.
  • Internal Collaboration: Works closely with Product, Strategy, Finance, and Legal to define partnership terms and new commercial models. Acts as the voice of the LATAM market to inform Sales Engineering and Network Planning on necessary infrastructure investments.

Duties And Responsibilities

This role's success is measured by strategic outcomes and long‑term pipeline growth, not immediate sales quota achievement.

  • Market Strategy & Penetration: Develop and execute a comprehensive LATAM Carrier Business Development plan, identifying white‑space opportunities, competitive threats, and potential strategic partners to secure GTT's long‑term competitive advantage.
  • Partnership Identification and Structuring: Proactively identify, qualify, and negotiate strategic agreements with major LATAM carriers (e.g., IXPs, Mobile Operators, Regional Tier 1/2 Carriers) to expand GTT's network footprint and service portfolio in the region.
  • Ecosystem Development: Cultivate a robust network of strategic channel and alliance partners to drive scalable, indirect distribution of GTT services.
  • Long‑Term Pipeline Generation: Establish a pipeline focused on multi‑year revenue potential stemming from new partnerships, joint ventures, and wholesale capacity swaps, ensuring sustainable growth.
  • Cultural and Business Acumen: Leverage deep regional knowledge and fluency in local business practices to effectively structure and manage relationships across diverse LATAM territories.
  • Reporting: Track and report on market penetration, new partnership launches, pipeline value of strategic deals, and the successful commercialization of new routes/services.

Required Experience / Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in a Business Development, Partnership Management, or Strategic Alliance role within the global telecommunications / technology sector focusing on the LATAM carrier market.
  • Demonstrated Success in Ecosystem Building: A proven track record of successfully identifying, negotiating, and launching complex, non‑standard commercial agreements (e.g., wholesale capacity swaps, joint GTM strategies, network peering).
  • Deep Regional Carrier Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the competitive landscape, regulatory environment, key contacts, and market trends across major LATAM countries.
  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts and financial modeling needed to assess partnership viability, structure favorable deals, and articulate the long‑term return on investment (ROI).
  • Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: Superior ability to influence, communicate, and negotiate with executive‑level stakeholders both internally and with external carrier partners.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and English is essential. Portuguese is a significant advantage, to effectively navigate business and cultural nuances in the region.
  • Networking and Relationship Capital: Existing strong relationships and a robust network within the executive and planning ranks of LATAM carrier accounts.
  • Ambition and Strategic Thinking: A proactive mindset focused on identifying and securing next‑generation opportunities and expanding GTT's strategic positioning, not just fulfilling immediate demand.

Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem‑solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Networking: Understanding the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.
  • Channel Sales: Knowledge of various channel sales strategies and solutions used to execute and fulfil a sales plan; ability to sell a hospitality organization's brand, products, and services through multiple and diverse avenues
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations: Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product / service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Universal Competencies

  • Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing): Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.
  • Operational Excellence: Understanding the system‑driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re‑focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.

EEO statement

GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non‑discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

GTT expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of GTT’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

CSC-PRESCRIBED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master's Degree preferably in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Office / Business Administration, Public Administration, Community Development, Economics, Sociology, Human Resource Management and/or Accounting

Must also have experience in disaster operations

Eligibility: Career Service (Professional); Second Level Eligibility

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Thorough understanding of RA: Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act
  • Must have enough knowledge regarding government laws and processes
  • Above average knowledge on use of MS Office
  • Great attention to details
  • Above average knowledge in planning / organizing / accounting / monitoring and evaluation
  • Above average knowledge on the management of warehouse / logistics / production / donation facilitation / processing / monitoring / financial and quality control standard setting / institutionalization of volunteers' assistance
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to work harmoniously, competently and effectively under pressure

JOB DESCRIPTION

Under direction and with substantial latitude for independent judgment, serves as the Division Chief and acts as the head of the Resource Management Division engaged in varied work ranging from routine to difficult and special work requiring training and moderate experiences or lower training but considerable experience and thorough knowledge pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers' deployment.

FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Directs, supervises, coordinates the review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidelines, systems and processes pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers' deployment.

Implements policies / mechanisms to ensure transparency and efficiency of procedures in the receipt, inventory, valuation, utilization and reporting of procured and donated items.

Recommends and supervises personnel that shall be assigned to assist in the donation facilitation in the "one-stop-shop" to be established by the government in times of disasters / calamities.

Supervises the receipt, warehousing, processing, production / packing / repacking and releasing of procured and donated goods as allocated by the Disaster Response Management Bureau.

Supervises the deployment of volunteers during the production / repacking of relief items in NROC and other production / repacking hubs that may be established / identified as extension of NROC during disaster relief operations.

Coordinates the establishment of institutional partnership with other government agencies, non-government organizations, private entities, people's organizations, etc., for logistical support in the transport of FFPs to FOs / disaster-affected areas / designated delivery sites consistent with the relief allocation plan and volunteer assistance during disaster operations at NROC.

Monitors the compliance of DSWD Disaster Response Centers and Field Office on the required number and type of relief items for stockpiling and prepositioning at any given time.

Submits reports and documentation pertaining to inventory management and recommends appropriate actions, policy improvement and submits recommendations necessary.

Supervises the implementation of the relief allocation plan submitted by Disaster Response Management Group in a timely manner.

Supervises the integration / consolidation of programs, activities and projects of NRLMB in the Work and Financial Plan which include targets, schedules and performance metrics.

Submits outputs of subordinates against performance standards and provides inputs to the Head of NRLMB in rating the performance of subordinates and in identifying performance gaps and proposed staff development interventions.

Resolves staff concerns and raises issues to the Head of NRLMB when beyond authority.

Updates the Head of NRLMB on the status of its deliverables / tasks regularly.

Provides supervisory and consultative assistance / services to the Head of NRLMB, partner / stakeholders and FOs and DRCs counterpart to address the challenges encountered on logistics and production in the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers' deployment.

Attends meetings, conferences and other activities on behalf of the Head of NRLMB as delegated.

Acts as resource person during seminars / training / workshops related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers' deployment, as requested.

Assures functions as the Head of NRLMB if the Head is on official travel / business or on leave of absence or other analogous circumstances resulting in inability to perform the duties of the position.

Performs other tasks as may be required by the Head of NRLMB.

JOB OUTPUTS

Enhanced policies, guidelines and procedures relative to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers' deployment.

Memorandum of Agreement with GOs, NGOs, POs, PAs, etc., relative to logistics and production during disaster operations.

Proposed Operations and Contingency Plan.

Consolidated Operations Reports (quarterly, semesterly and annually) of NRLMB.

Updates, Memoranda and other office communications.

Technical assistance to DRCs, FOs, LGUs, intermediaries and stakeholders.

CRITERIA FOR EVALUATION

Education: 25%

Training: 10%

Experience: 25%

IQT: 10%

Technical Exam: 15%

Interview: 10%

Performance Review: 5%

Total: 100%

Obtain 80% of the maximum total score or 48 points in Education, Training, and Experience (ETE).

FINAL SHORTLISTING

Top five (5) highest rating but overall rating should not be less than 85%.

Rizo, Director IV of Human Resource Management and Development Service; Please note that wrong or lacking information thereof shall render the application void.

Duly accomplished, subscribed and sworn / notarized Personal Data Sheet (PDS) with a recent passport-size picture and thumb mark and Work Experience Sheet.

Certificate / s of Employment (COE) – required for work experiences acquired outside DSWD Central Office.

For CSC Passers only: photocopy of CSC rating / Verified Eligibility.

title: OPERADOR DE GUINDASTE
description:
Descrição

Operar equipamento de movimentação e / ou elevação de cargas do tipo guindaste, realizando

operações de carga e descarga ou no pátio atendendo solicitações de trabalhos específicos

ou programados. Operam máquinas e equipamentos de elevação, ajustando comandos, acionando

movimentos das máquinas. Avaliam condições de funcionamento das máquinas e equipamentos,

interpretando painel de instrumentos de medição, verificando fonte de alimentação,

testando comandos de acionamento. Preparam área para operação dos equipamentos e

transportam pessoas e materiais em máquinas e equipamentos de elevação. Trabalham seguindo

normas de segurança, higiene, qualidade e proteção ao meio ambiente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Zelar pelo bom estado do equipamento no que diz respeito a manutenção e boa utilização.

Elaborar o check list a fim de identificar qualquer avaria causada ao equipamento e

informar ao supervisor. Verificar se o equipamento está devidamente isolado em um raio de

operação, a fim de evitar abalroamento com outros equipamentos. Verificar a necessidade de

abastecimento do equipamento e informar ao supervisor. Verificar a capacidade de içamento

de cada equipamento e atentar-se para a operação de acordo com a carga. Içar mercadorias

dos navios, utilizando o guindaste, posicionando-as em locais apropriados do pátio ou

navio, para fins de armazenagem e posterior embarque ou desembarque. Retirar eventualmente

do pátio, as mercadorias que serão colocadas no convés do navio, usando guindaste e

colocando nas carretas a fim de encaminhar ao costado do navio e posterior recarga.

Executar rotinas de transporte de material necessários às operações no armazém, utilizando

guindaste, objetivando otimizar o tempo de processo. Cuidar da organização do espaço

físico destinado às cargas, dividindo-os no pátio e efetuando a armazenagem de forma

adequada. Posicionar materiais em local adequado através da operação de guindaste,

retirando cargas que eventualmente fiquem espalhadas, a fim de facilitar o trânsito de

veículos e outros equipamentos. Realizar eventualmente tarefas correlatas, determinadas

pela chefia imediata. Participar, diariamente, do DDS. Utilizar, corretamente, todos os

equipamentos de segurança (EPI).

É responsabilidade do operador manter o equipamento em condições de funcionalidade, sendo

responsável por tarefas complementares à manutenção, bem como inspeção e encaminhamento

para correção de eventuais defeitos e falhas observadas

Ensino Médio CompletoCurso de Operador de Guindaste.

title: Host City Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
description:
Host City Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Department : Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Employment Type : Fixed Term - Full Time

Location : Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host City Manager will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Host City Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte
  • Brasília
  • Fortaleza
  • Porto Alegre
  • Recife
  • Rio de Janeiro
  • Salvador
  • São Paulo

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently
